items.confidence: Delta Cargo公开告警已读取；未取得BOS机场或其他航司统一货运限制通知
items.fact: Delta Cargo告警称，因BOS运行受持续燃油供应中断影响，即刻至2026年9月28日23:59 EST，对所有往返BOS的Delta航班实施临时货运限制：Delta Mainline仅DSH、DMD、DHV例外，Delta Connection全部产品禁运。
items.impact: 业务推断：影响仅限Delta承运的BOS相关货物，可能需要改配其他承运人或延期；不能扩大为BOS机场关闭、全部航司禁运或全美东北部货运中断。
items.action: 涉及Delta BOS进出港的单票，核对产品代码、实际承运航班、是否可改走其他航司及9月28日23:59 EST后的恢复通知。
items.titleEn: Delta Cargo places temporary BOS cargo restrictions due to fuel supply disruption
items.factEn: Delta Cargo said an ongoing fuel supply disruption affecting BOS operations led to temporary restrictions through 23:59 EST on September 28, 2026, for all Delta flights to and from BOS. Delta Mainline embargoes all products except DSH, DMD and DHV; Delta Connection embargoes all products.
items.impactEn: Business inference: this affects Delta-carried BOS shipments and may require rerouting or delay. It does not prove BOS airport closure, an all-airline embargo, or a wider Northeast air cargo shutdown.
items.actionEn: For Delta BOS shipments, verify product code, operating flight, alternative carrier options, and any post-September 28 23:59 EST resumption notice.

items.title: Air Peace称ABV运行受Jet A1短缺影响，ABV—MIU另受日落后VFR限制
items.confidence: Nairametrics读取到Air Peace声明转述；未取得机场、空管或货运部门原始通知
items.fact: Nairametrics 9月27日报道，Air Peace称ABV初始延误由Jet A1燃油不可用造成，且影响ABV其他航司；燃油可用后受影响航班恢复。其ABV—MIU服务随后因MIU塔台改称机场转为VFR且日落后不再运行而取消，航司称安排次日执行。
items.impact: 业务推断：尼日利亚国内腹舱、快件和机场衔接可能受燃油供应与目的机场运行限制影响；但当前证据只覆盖Air Peace相关航班，不能扩大为ABV、MIU或尼日利亚全网货运停运。
items.action: 涉及尼日利亚国内空运或经ABV衔接的货物，向承运人和当地代理核实燃油、可运行时段、次日补班和货站接货安排。
items.titleEn: Air Peace says ABV operations were hit by Jet A1 shortage, with ABV-MIU also affected by post-sunset VFR limits
items.factEn: Nairametrics reported on September 27 that Air Peace said initial ABV delays were caused by unavailable Jet A1 fuel, also affecting other airlines at Abuja. After fuel became available, affected flights resumed. Its ABV-MIU service was then unable to operate because the MIU tower said the airport had become VFR and would not operate beyond sunset; the airline said the cancelled service was arranged for the following day.
items.impactEn: Business inference: Nigerian domestic belly cargo, express and airport connections may be affected by fuel availability and destination airport operating limits. The evidence currently covers Air Peace flights only and should not be expanded to an ABV, MIU or nationwide cargo shutdown.
items.actionEn: For Nigerian domestic air cargo or ABV connections, verify fuel status, operating hours, recovery flight timing and cargo acceptance with the carrier and local agent.
